scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k -n vite,electron "npm run dev -w frontend" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env AGENTICCREW_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron electron/main.cjs"
scripts.electron:start: npm run build -w frontend && electron electron/main.cjs
scripts.frontend:quality: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run coverage
scripts.quality: npm run frontend:quality && npm run worker:quality
scripts.worker:quality: npm run worker:test && npm run worker:lint && npm run worker:typecheck
